visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a static portrait of a young woman with long, wavy dark hair and a bright smile, wearing a white and pink sporty top against a plain off-white background. Two layers of text boxes with black and white captions appear at the bottom of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor television studio where two women are standing. The woman on the left has short dark hair and wears a white polka-dot blouse with black pants, while the woman on the right has shoulder-length brown hair and wears a mint green ruffled dress. They stand in front of a traditional floral folding screen. (3) The camera remains in a medium shot as the two women talk enthusiastically. The woman in the green dress uses large hand gestures and maintains a smiling, energetic expression. Cartoonish graphics of girls drinking tea and heart shapes pop up near the bottom to decorate the interview. (4) The final phase shifts to a static long shot of a coastline under an overcast sky. Gentle waves are seen rolling onto the sand. Multiple lines of white text appear one after another in the center of the frame, conveying a long message before fading into a final black screen with a single title.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 國光女神梁云菲驚傳輕生獲救! [Subtitle]: 生命永遠都有出路，請別放棄. (2) [Subtitle]: 還記得她在節目上活潑開朗的模樣. (3) [Subtitle]: 最近云菲變漂亮了. [Subtitle]: 因為她分手了!! [Variety]: 三姑六婆上身. (4) [Variety]: 愛開玩笑. (5) [Subtitle]: 藝術作品登上羅浮宮 全台女星第一人. [Subtitle]: 其實一直都有在藝術就是這個領域耕耘. (6) [Slogan]: 小編想說. (7) [Subtitle]: 有時候，我們只看見陽光燦爛的笑容，卻忘記笑容的背後，都可能藏有傷痛… 如果妳正努力活著、請記得，妳已經很勇敢了。 妳有才華、妳會發光！妳值得被愛，值得被看見。 而我們，都在這裡，陪你一起走。 (8) [Slogan]: 宜起自由. [Slogan]: 宜起勇敢! 宜起自由!
